resolutions.researcher_notes: [GANZHOU-SOUTH-FUELSOURCE-RULING-2026-09-10] ORCHESTRATOR RULING -- ONE BRANCH, TWO SOURCES. The four Ganzhou South Branch rows (P4785 大余-信丰段, P4786 会昌-寻乌段, P4787 龙南-全南段, P4788 信丰-瑞金段) are segments of one hydraulically connected branch fed at both ends, so FuelSource on all four is 'West-East Gas Pipeline 2, West-East Gas Pipeline 3' and the 川气东送 half of the sheet's P4787/P4788 value is dropped. Sourcing: the operator's own 2024 emergency plan states the branch's sources exhaustively as 西二线149#阀室 (Dayu) 或 西三线瑞金分输清管站, in the document that names three of these four segments, and 川气东送 does not occur once in its 321 pages; the 2021 江西日报/江西发布 announcement names all eight supplied counties off the Ruijin WEP3 station with the Dayu WEP2 tie-in as the second, then-future source and 双气源双向供气 as the end state; and 全南县's own 2024 reply records WEP2 as the gas the county actually started taking at end-2022. CCXI 2022 assigns 川气东送 to the PHASE I provincial network (天然气管道公司) while these are Phase II rows (管道分公司, 承接西气东输二线气源). resolutions.researcher_notes: NEW EVIDENCE -- the sheet's StartYear1=2018 (and, more weakly, ConstructionYear=2017) cannot stand. Four independent documents place the segment under construction in 2021 and only in service from late 2022: (1) Quannan county DRC 变更请示 published 2021-09-06, (2) Jiangxi's 2021 key-projects list, (3) CCXI 2022 rating report (still building as of 2022-03), (4) the operator's 2024 plan ('运行未满三年' as of 2024-09-20). Huichang county reports 通气 in Nov 2022. Recommendation: change StartYear1 to 2022 (staged in the Start[ref] record) and treat ConstructionYear=2017 as the EIA-approval year, not a construction start (a 2018 construction start is the better reading if a source is ever found: Ganzhou reported all 12 provincial branches in its territory 'in substantive construction' by end-2018). Separately, the carried 340.3 km vs 131.8 km straight-line question is RESOLVED in favour of the sheet: the plan's station list (龙南、定南、安远、会昌) shows the line loops south through Longnan before turning east to Ruijin, so 340.3 km is the real routed length and only the two-terminal NAME is misleading. No existence or duplication concern -- the row is real and operating.

[OLSN-PASTE-DEFECT-2026-09-10] OtherLanguageSegmentName ON THIS ROW IS NOT A SEGMENT NAME. It is a 22-character slice of one prose sentence that was chunked at a fixed width and pasted down six consecutive rows, SheetRow 2672-2677 (P4785-P4790). This row holds '丰段、进贤段；赣州南支线信丰瑞金段、上犹崇义'. The siblings hold P4785='目前开工建设井冈'; P4786='山支线、井开区支线；靖安支线、湘东支线、赣州'; P4787='南支线大余信丰段；于都宁都石城段、宁都广昌南'; P4789='段、樟树新干峡江段、井开区吉水永丰段、赣州南'; P4790='支线（信丰-龙南-定南段）等项目'. Two proofs it is one sliced string, not six names: the four interior chunks are all exactly 22 characters (a width, not a name), and all five seams split a word (井冈|山支线, 赣州|南支线, 广昌南|丰段, 上犹崇义|段, 赣州南|支线（) so no chunk stands alone. Reassembled the 112 characters are one grammatical sentence: '目前开工建设井冈山支线、井开区支线；靖安支线、湘东支线、赣州南支线大余信丰段；于都宁都石城段、宁都广昌南丰段、进贤段；赣州南支线信丰瑞金段、上犹崇义段、樟树新干峡江段、井开区吉水永丰段、赣州南支线（信丰-龙南-定南段）等项目' -- a 'currently under construction' branch list. So the cell is corrupt on all six rows, including P4785's, whose chunk carries no separators and so looks less obviously broken; and the fragment does not even describe its own row (P4790's names 信丰-龙南-定南段 while the row is 井开区-吉水-永丰-乐安-宜黄). Anything keying on this column -- name matching, dedup, discovery guards -- is matching sentence debris; it already produced one false positive, the 靖安 hit that made the tendered 安义-靖安支线 look like it might already be tracked. RECOMMENDED for this row: '赣州南支线 (信丰-瑞金段)', taken from the row's own OtherLanguageAlternativePipelineNames ('二期工程, 赣州南支线 (信丰-瑞金段)'), the live convention in this cell being the bare branch name (cf. P4780 = 上高支线). Deliberately staged as detection only, with no proposed `values`: the exact form the cell should take is a column-semantics call, and the corrupt text is evidence of a paste, not of any research finding, so nothing here changes a sourced value. Verified against data/GGIT_gas_snapshot_20260910.csv.
